learnings.title: GitHub changelog feed: GitHub Desktop adds short-lived authentication tokens
learnings.claim: GitHub changelog feed fetched 2026-11-03 lists as newest item: "GitHub Desktop adds short-lived authentication tokens" (Tue, 03 Nov 2026 07:55:58 +0000). Not independently verified.
learnings.decision: REVIEW_ONLY: The system plan should assess the security benefits and potential workflow impacts of GitHub Desktop's short-lived authentication tokens to ensure future compatibility, taking no immediate action.
learnings.next_measurement: Reviewer opens the item link and confirms relevance before promotion.
